scope: This Mac only; no Linux/FreeBSD/KPart/hosted CI acceptance.
planned_large_viewport_deviation: 240x80 clamps to 239x65 in native Ghostty on the 1440x900 logical display; verified common 220x60 chosen before optimization. Timing thresholds unchanged.
font: Menlo 10 pt (12x23 physical-pixel cell on this 2x display); independent Kwi/Ghostty padding
floor_rationale: Half the slowest native Ghostty median across the four frozen cases, rounded to the nearest 5 MiB/s; uniform floor plus >=90% of matching preserved Kwi baseline. A parser floor is not rendered throughput acceptance.
memory: 100 warm-up cycles, then >=5 equal batches of 100 fixed-content tab cycles; record settled footprint and RSS. No reproducible monotonic retained-memory slope.
instrumentation: Compare untraced DSR and coarse/full tracing; <=5% coarse median throughput budget. Clock is Darwin MONOTONIC_RAW.
presentation: DSR, Qt event echo and frame callbacks are diagnostic intervals. Actual input-to-pixel presentation must remain unverified if not measured.
